description:
Powerful 200W Motor & 3-Speed Control: Equipped with a robust 200W motor and three adjustable speed settings (6/8/10 MPH), the S1 Electric Motocross Bike delivers smooth acceleration perfect for beginners and confident young riders. Its motorcycle-style throttle ensures intuitive control while maintaining safe, manageable speeds.

Vibrant 7-Color RGB Lighting & Smart Display: Dynamic multicolor LED lights create an exciting riding atmosphere day or night. The integrated LED screen clearly shows speed, battery level and mode settings, with all controls conveniently built into the handlebar thumb throttle for easy operation.
UL2271 Certified Battery & US Standard Charger: Powered by a high-quality BYD battery using BAK 18650 cells with UL2271 certification for maximum safety. The included wall charger features US standard plug configuration and UL certification for worry-free charging and extended riding time.
Adjustable Ergonomic Design & Durable Construction: Features an aluminum alloy frame with height-adjustable seat and handlebars that grow with your child. The 12×2.5" pneumatic tires provide excellent shock absorption, while the reliable band brake system ensures safe, confident stopping power.
Authentic Motorcycle Style with Safety Features: Designed with realistic motorcycle aesthetics in two color schemes - blue with yellow decals or black with red decals. Includes kickstand for easy parking and meets all US safety standards, making it perfect for neighborhood adventures and imaginative play.
